name: Please Eat This!
source:
What do you do when your friend gets too picky to eat anything at all? Whip up something that they'll love, of course! 

You might not be the best chef, but you're not leaving until they take a bite.

[From [url=https://aiainaine.itch.io/please-eat-this]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果你的朋友太挑食，根本不吃任何东西，你会怎么做？当然是做一些他们会喜欢的东西！

你可能不是最好的厨师，但在他们咬一口之前你不会离开。

[来自[url=https://aiainaine.itch.io/please-eat-this]itch.io[/url]]
